name: Tsubasa Heaven
source:
One night, high school teacher Kuzuki happens to meet his student, Haneishi, at a convenience store.
He goes to dinner with her and keeps it a secret from his pregnant wife and everyone at school... Will that act send him to heaven or hell?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17839]Freem![/url]]
translation:
某天夜里，高中教师葛木在便利店偶遇自己的学生羽石。
他瞒着怀孕的妻子与学校里的所有人，和她一起去吃饭……这个举动，最终会将他带向天堂，还是地狱？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17839]Freem![/url]]
